note: The worked example (tools/quests/homelands/README.md). The Roost's people are tools/worlds/homelands.json's (Aviak Village): Elder Kraawk gives the first two, Huntmaster Arrok beside him the three hunts; Weaver Tikkri is the outfitter, Coachman Harrek keeps the stable (his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes); the scrub rats (the grass to the north), the brush wasps (the hill to the west) and the boar Razortusk (the east rise) are placed for these quests. Levels 7-20 (2026-11-11): Arrok gives L7-L15, Kraawk the L20 path; their objectives are on the Homelands' shared ground, the Goldfeather Eyrie (tools/worlds/homelands.json's shared block: the outpost on the frozen river, reached by Harrek's coach), whose people (Quartermaster Dunmore, Warden Halvek, Scout Feyla) and creatures every home's chain shares. Its drops are the shared ground's: copy their blocks as they are.

L1.name: A Fledgling's Wingband
offer: Another fledgling, fresh from the egg! Every young one of the Roost wears a wingband before its first hunt, so the sentinels know it for ours.
Weaver Tikkri knots them from reed and down. Her loom is a short hop north-west of here.
Will you fetch your wingband and show it to me?
L1.declined: The Roost will wait for you, little one.
L1.started: Go on, then. Tikkri's loom is just north-west of here.

piece.name: fledgling's wingband
piece.description: A band of knotted reed and down. Every fledgling of the Roost wears one on its wing.

fetch.journal: Ask Weaver Tikkri, north-west of Elder Kraawk, for a fledgling's wingband.
fetch.says: The elder sent you? Hold out your wing. There: reed for strength, down for luck. No charge for a fledgling.

show.journal: Show the fledgling's wingband to Elder Kraawk.
show.says: It sits well on you. Wear it, and the Roost will always know its own.

L2.name: Bound to the Roost
offer: The winds carry fledglings far, and not always gently. Have Spiritmaster Kreeal bind your spirit to the Roost, so that you wake here if you fall.
Then give your name to Coachman Harrek for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
L2.declined: Then fly low until you do.
L2.started: Kreeal keeps the spirit perch to the south-west. Harrek's stable is on the path south of here.

bind.journal: Have Spiritmaster Kreeal, south-west of the elder, bind your spirit to the Roost.
bind.says: It is done. Should you fall, you will wake here among your own. Now go and give Coachman Harrek your name.

ledger.journal: Give your name to Coachman Harrek, south of the elder, for his ledger.
ledger.says: Welcome to my stable, fledgling. My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

says: Good. Now you will always find your way back to us.
Harrek's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the flight to Halas is earned. Huntmaster Arrok, beside me, has work for you.

L3.name: Rats Among the Seed
offer: So you are the new fledgling. Good. Scrub rats are into the seed stores again, and the grocer is squawking.
Hunt them on the grass north of the Roost and bring me three of their tails. Then I will teach you something worth knowing.
Will you hunt them?
L3.declined: Then the rats eat well tonight.

drop.name: scrub rat tail
drop.description: The tail of a scrub rat from the grass north of the Roost.

hunt.journal: Take three scrub rat tails from the scrub rats on the grass north of the Roost.

give.journal: Bring three scrub rat tails to Huntmaster Arrok.
give.says: Three tails, and all your feathers still in place. You can fight. Now watch closely, and learn this.

L4.name: A Fledgling's Arms
offer: Bare talons will not serve you in the north. I will make you proper gear, but you will fetch what I need.
Weaver Tikkri has leather and a good shaft for me. Then take a stinger from the brush wasps on the hill west of the Roost.
Will you bring me all three?
L4.declined: Then keep to your talons, and to the nest.
L4.started: Leather and a shaft from Tikkri, a stinger from the wasps. Go.

materials.journal: Ask Weaver Tikkri for the leather strip and the wooden shaft.
materials.says: For Arrok? Here, a strip of leather and a straight shaft. Tell him he owes me a rat pelt.

drop.name: brush wasp stinger
drop.description: The stinger of a brush wasp from the hill west of the Roost.

hunt.journal: Take a brush wasp stinger from the brush wasps on the hill west of the Roost.

give.journal: Bring the leather strip, the wooden shaft and the brush wasp stinger to Huntmaster Arrok.
give.says: All three. Give me a moment... there. It is yours: carry it well.

L5.name: Old Razortusk
offer: One task more before the winds take you north. An old boar we call Razortusk has gored two of our foragers on the east rise.
He is mean and he is quick, so strike first. Bring me his tusk, and I will teach you the last thing I have for a fledgling.
Will you hunt Razortusk?
L5.declined: He will not grow gentler while you wait.
L5.started: East, up the rise past the market nests. Do not let him get behind you.

drop.name: Razortusk's tusk
drop.description: The chipped tusk of the old boar Razortusk.

hunt.journal: Take Razortusk's tusk from the old boar Razortusk on the rise east of the Roost.

give.journal: Bring Razortusk's tusk to Huntmaster Arrok.
says: Razortusk's own tusk! The foragers will sleep easier. You are a fledgling no longer.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Windwhistle when you are ready to fly north.

flight.name: The Long Flight
offer: The winds are fair for the north. The barbarians of Halas fight the giants beside us, and they will train you as their own.
You have earned the long flight, fledgling. I will set you down among your own guild in Halas, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you north?
flight.declined: The winds will wait for you.
flight.started: Fly well, and do not forget the Roost!
flight.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Windwhistle when you are ready to fly to Halas.

L7.name: Two Tasks on the Ice
offer: The Homelands keep a hunters' outpost on the frozen river under the Goldfeather Eyrie. Every home sends its young hunters there, and so will the Roost.
Ride Harrek's coach to the Eyrie. Bring me drift rat fur and a badger's pelt from the snow east of the outpost.
Will you hunt the Eyrie's snow for me?
L7.declined: The snow will keep. Come back when you are ready.
L7.started: Harrek's coach will take you. Keep your feathers warm.

drop.name: drift rat fur
drop.description: A clump of white fur from a drift rat of the Goldfeather Eyrie's snow.

hunt.journal: Take two clumps of drift rat fur from the drift rats east of the Eyrie outpost.

drop.name: snowfield badger pelt
drop.description: The thick pelt of a snowfield badger of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take a snowfield badger pelt from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the drift rat fur and the badger pelt to Huntmaster Arrok.
give.says: Good fur, and a good pelt. The cold did not frighten you. Now watch closely, and learn this.

L10.name: Arms of the Eyrie
offer: You have grown past the arms a fledgling carries. I will make you better, but the outpost has what I need.
Quartermaster Dunmore keeps good ore at the Eyrie outpost. Then bring me silk from the rime spiders north-east of it.
Will you bring me the ore and the silk?
L10.declined: Then your old arms will have to do.
L10.started: Ore from Dunmore, silk from the spiders. Go.

materials.journal: Ask Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost for the ore Arrok needs.
materials.says: Arrok's hunter? His word came by the coach. Here, the best ore in my stores. Do not drop it in the river.

drop.name: rime spider silk
drop.description: A skein of frosted silk from a rime spider of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take two skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the iron ore and the rime spider silk to Huntmaster Arrok.
give.says: Ore for the blade, silk to bind the grip. A moment... there. It is yours: carry it well.

L13.name: Old Frostjaw
offer: The outpost's hunters have lost three of their own to an old snow leopard they call Frostjaw. He hunts the slopes north-east of the outpost.
Bring him down, and I will teach you what the Roost teaches its hunters at your age. Take friends from the other homes if you are wise.
Will you hunt Old Frostjaw?
L13.declined: He will not grow old enough to die on his own.
L13.started: Go with friends. He strikes first and he strikes hard.

hunt.journal: Kill Old Frostjaw on the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

back.says: Frostjaw is gone? Then the outpost sleeps easier, and so do I. Learn this.

L15.name: The Heart of the Rime
offer: Something old walks in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost. The hunters call it the Rimeheart, and the cold that follows it kills the snow's game.
Break it, and carry a shard of it to Warden Halvek, so the outpost knows it is done. Then come back to me.
Will you face the Rimeheart?
L15.started: Do not go into those caves alone.

drop.name: shard of the Rimeheart
drop.description: A shard of blue ice that never melts, broken from the Rimeheart.

hunt.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

carry.journal: Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
carry.says: So the Rimeheart is broken. I will send word to every home. Tell Arrok the Eyrie owes the Roost a debt.

back.says: Halvek's word came by the coach before you did. You have done the Roost proud. Learn this.

L20.name: The Long Watch
offer: Arrok says you are no fledgling now. A hunter of the Roost stands the long watch at the Eyrie once, so the other homes know our feathers.
Go to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost and do as he asks. When it is done, come back to me, and choose your path.
Will you stand the long watch?
L20.declined: The watch waits for those who are ready.

road.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
road.says: Kraawk sends you? Then you are ready for the eyrie. Scout Feyla watches it from the river's far reach: go to her.

road.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
road.says: The Goldfeather raiders carry their eyrie's war-talons. Bring me three, and they will think twice before they raid the river again.

drop.name: Goldfeather war-talon
drop.description: A war-talon of the Goldfeather aviaks, bound in gold thread.

hunt.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.

handin.journal: Bring the three war-talons to Scout Feyla.
handin.says: Three talons. The eyrie will be quiet tonight. Go home, hunter: your elder waits for you.

final.journal: Return to Elder Kraawk in the Roost.
final.says: You flew out a fledgling and came home a hunter of the Homelands. The Roost has one more thing to give you.
